title: Fix two bugs in a pagination helper
instruction:
paginate.py has two bugs. Fix them.

paginate(items, page, per_page) must return the items on a 1-indexed page, so page 1 is the first page. It must return an empty list for a page beyond the last page, and raise ValueError when page < 1 or per_page < 1.

page_count(total, per_page) must return how many pages are needed, rounding up, and 0 when total is 0. It must raise ValueError when per_page < 1.

The visible tests are in test_paginate.py. Do not edit that file.
